items.note: The plan follows the proof at 741-765: the eight-row schedule, the net change (JV+RG)x independent of the scratch vectors a,c, the bit and complex central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, and the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). It also gives the neighbour counts and wire counts W_b, W_c. It does not say that stage j varies coordinate j, a small omission.

It has the shared gate frame, the edge change D_vD_u^{-1}, the invariant 'stored = frame applied to logical', commutation with pointwise gates by linearity, the endpoint operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the route formula with sign eps_w including auxiliary roles. This is exactly the paper's argument at 804-825.

The plan states and derives everything the item needs: the pairing |S∩T|-1 (F_2 dot product for the complex net), the terminal labels, the interstage transitions, the eight gate labels, the full residual table, the single decreasing class (center 3->4, loss h), L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539. It does not derive the lemma's last clause, the existence of binary orthonormal bases (1073-1102). Its claim and S0.1.1.1.4.6.14 contain small slips, listed as errors.

It assigns P_U to gates and sinks and -P_{U_a} to sources, shows the rank of nested projection differences equals the dimension change, adds the extra rank-one edge 2P_{U_a} for each of the N sources, gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m, and gives the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m. The shear frame Phi_M and the result Phi_{I_m} on every role appear in S0.1.1.2.1. This matches 1156-1172.

It follows 1231-1315 step by step: weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd weight of unit vectors, the phase i^{eps[v.x]} rewritten as a translation kernel, frames I and C^{⊗m} for the zero and full labels, C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates for X_a->Y_a, Z wrappers with i^{27k}, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m. Tensoring over k columns is implicit but present in C^{⊗mk}.

It has L/N<1/2, both s<Wm, the exact deficits eta_b and eta_c, the bound m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta) from log m<20, and the conclusion s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This is the paper's computation at 1319-1346.

The plan uses these operations repeatedly (O(V) lower-triangular updates, cyclic row splits, single-bit moves, controlled cyclic shifts) and lists elementary-stream-ops and controlled-shift as prerequisites. No step states the lemmas' content, for example the y ↦ y+a(controls) mod q^b update with b^{O(1)} offset cost.

It gives the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 by elimination from the topmost nonzero row and its rightmost entry, the fixed odd prime, lower-triangular updates in descending order at O(V), the sandwich E_2/E_1^{-1}/ΠD/E_1/E_2^{-1}, and the one-interchange realization of each H_i ← H_i+D_j. This matches 1375-1447. The prime's extra condition on diagonal numerators (1416) is not mentioned.

It covers the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on edges by recursive interchanges, output Phi_{I_m} on every role, the merge undoing rho, the three shears, s recursive calls, F_0=O(1) and F_k ≤ (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric-sum case split, and the fixed-tape parking schedule. This is the paper's proof at 1491-1588.

It has rho top digits as the row field (q^{2rho} ≥ W^k), the four field orders, padding to R'<2R, the base-m decomposition with cost O(V)Σ a_j m^{jτ}=O(Ve^τ), binary-to-radix-q padding, and unequal widths by one single-bit move. This matches 1649-1762.

It gives C and its identities, the edge product over a residual basis, conjugation by P_M into coordinate directions, slots and columns for e=mf, one child per residual vector with the (C^{-1})^{⊗f} identity for inverse kernels, Gaussian elimination into a fixed number of row additions, exactly s_c children on f axes, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D. This matches 1835-1940.

It reproduces the eight parity updates and their cycles, the result (u+c(1-2(u mod 2)),w), guarded segments with the bad set 10 ≤ g ≤ 2^{K-1}-11 and its union bound, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting only B, repair by radix sort of the extracted records, the separate top position, and the asymptotic cost O(V(L^τ+1)), including its use for a whole change of basis. This is the paper's proof at 2013-2231.

It has the node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)), the rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, the 1/W child volume, F(e) ≤ (s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) with leaves O(e) below d^β, internal sum O(e^λ), leaf sum O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{λ'}). This matches 2286-2445. The parent claims S0.1.1.1.6 and S0.1.1.3.3 phrase the result loosely (see errors).

It states the exact-then-truncate layer in O(Vd^{λ'}) with error < sqrt2·2^{-p}. It derives the guard width Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ from A(e) ≤ sA(e/m)+E and leaves 8e, gives Δ=o(p) via εC_1<1, and gives the disk-preservation argument. This follows 2450-2586 and 2736-2757.

It covers character cancellation without division, the decimation-in-frequency recursion, the bit-reversed storage B_t, the reverse procedure giving F_t^+B_t^{-1}, grouped rounds, the prefix-slot and chunk-exchange layout with costs O(TpdK) and O(Tp·pK^{τ-1}), fast-layer rounds O(Tpℓd^{λ'}), the commuting truncation J_E Q_p=Q_p J_E, and error ℓ·sqrt2·2^{-p}. This matches 2819-3200.

It gives evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the four products with the established multiplier, the separation |h_j| < B_0/2, carries in {-1,0} and {0,1}, centred residues, negacyclic reduction, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost, as at 3233-3368.

It has the retained LB order with P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the normalisation F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), the error chain 2δ+η, then 3δ+η, then M(3δ+η)=sqrt2·M(3ℓ+1)2^{-p}, and the cost O(Tp log(rp)) for products. This follows 3414-3495.

It gives the identity TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, the Neumann inverse of N=CTD, the rescaled contractions with product 2^{-2α^2}, the error and time table, the ordered selection C, and the unexecuted sorts. The tensor form has γ=2dα^2, error dp^2, and costs O(dTp^{3/2+δ}α) and O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)). This matches 3576-3897.

It has periodicity of a, the coefficient computation giving QF_t, the dilation identity F^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F^+, commutation with pointwise products, and the two normalisations giving (u*v)/S^2, as at 3938-3983. It does not state the conjugation trick for RF^+ (3934-3935, 3983-3987).

It has all fixed constants, the sizes and comparison bands, α and γ=o(b), primes via the Rosser-Schoenfeld interval bound, disjoint windows, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, α^4θ_i>p, trial-division search in n^{o(1)}, and no wraparound with c_j<2^{3b}. This matches 4016-4193.

It gives the isomorphism from the order of the image of x, the triangular digits b_i, updates in order i=d..1, preservation of the valid box, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, O(d^2) axis moves, and cost O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)), as at 4216-4292.

It has well-definedness, the diagonal isometric isomorphism, the wrap check ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, the formula M_C=D_-ι^{-1}M_r(ιD_+f,ιD_+g)=(f*g)/T, and the computed twist sequence. The twist errors of 4 each are accounted for in S0.1.14.3.

It gives the chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart 2^γ B_0 QF_t A = RF_s, digit input scaled by 2^{-b-2}, the six steps, and the two occurrences of S undoing (u*v)/S^2. This matches 4486-4544. The definition of F̃^+ by conjugation is not stated explicitly.

It follows the error chain through E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9·2^γTL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2) and E_w<28·2^γT^2L to the final bound 448b·2^{-3b/4}<1/2, then exact rounding and the carry invariant. This matches 4555-4795.

It has the seven table rows with their powers of p, the margins g_1..g_7 with minimum 2^{-181}=2κ, the justification of the rows, setup p^{A+C}=o(Tp), absorption of log powers by p^κ, the final O(n(log n)^{1-κ}), and the schoolbook cutoff. This matches 4857-4995. The exceptional-stream sorting bound (4951-4973) is covered only through S0.1.1.3.2.14.
S0 asserts that the bound disproves the n log n optimality conjecture, but no step explains the eventual-lower-bound formulation or the liminf argument (379-387).

errors.says: Motivation: subspace labels make the deficit Wm-s equal 'twice the total number of loss minus source ranks'.
errors.paper: The deficit from W_b m is N-2L_b, and from W_c m it is 2N-2L_c. In both cases it is source ranks minus twice the loss, not twice the loss minus source ranks. The sub-steps S0.1.1.1.4.8.1 and S0.1.1.1.4.9.2 state the correct values.

errors.says: The labels are built from triple indicators 'pairing as |σ∩σ'|-1', stated for both the bit and the complex network.
errors.paper: The pairing |S∩T|-1 is the rational form x^T(I-J/9)y of the bit network only. The complex network uses F=F_2^h with the ordinary dot product. S0.1.1.1.4.1 states this correctly.

errors.says: The side edge 0->2 gains residual of dimension (a-1)(h-1)+1 'using that the two triples are orthogonal'.
errors.paper: The 0->2 residual (B⊗t_Y^⊥)⊥(P⊗<t_X>) follows from splitting A=B⊥P and F=<t>⊥t^⊥. Only the side edge 2->5 uses the neighbour relation t_X⊥t_Y essentially.

errors.says: The recurrence solves to O(e^τ) for the bit network and O(e^λ) for the complex one.
errors.paper: For the complex network, internal costs sum to O(e^λ) but leaves add O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}). The layer bound O(d^{λ'}) comes only after summing base-m pieces with λ' > max{λ, σ+β(1-σ)}. S0.1.1.1.6.2 and S0.1.1.3.4 state this correctly.

errors.says: Per-node overheads are polynomial in p and absorbed by the length of the polynomial record.
errors.paper: The per-node overhead (basis changes, gates, corrections, reassembly) is O(V((eK)^τ+1)). Only descriptor and address work that is polynomial in p per record or node is absorbed by the record length. S0.1.1.3.3.2 states the overhead correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from the digit convolution to the final bound. The steps are: the CRT map, Gaussian resampling with retained permutations, the chirp, the twist, and the ring convolution by synthetic transforms whose layouts and layers use the two rank-saving procedures (bit-network interchange and phase-frame butterfly layer); then exact recovery and the cost table with minimum margin 2κ. Each link is derived from the paper's own sub-steps. The tree thins only at the edges. The stream primitives are used but never stated. The parent claims of S0.1.1.1.6 and S0.1.1.3.3 compress the complex recurrence and the node overhead loosely; the correct forms appear in their sub-steps. The 'disproving' clause is asserted without the liminf argument.

steps.note: It fixes h=100, v=C(100,3), N=v^3 and m=h^3, and gives the scalar network whose forward/inverse/forward invocations send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) and restore every scratch wire. The triple indexing appears through u_a=t_{a_1}⊗t_{a_2}⊗t_{a_3}.
It has a common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and edges costing only D_vD_u^{-1}.
It has nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges being center 3->4 with loss h, with the full gate-label and residual tables.
It states that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, and that the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions where the dimension change is zero.
It gives Σ|Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich (source dims N, sink dims Wm-N, 2L for the losses), and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.

It has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, and s_b<W_b m and s_c<W_c m (the complex deficit 2N-2L_c is stated). The bit deficit N-2L_b is implicit in s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, and the motivation of S0.1.1.1.4 misstates the deficit's form.
It has M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, through P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m, so the network outputs Phi_{I_m}, the shear H ← H+D, on every role including scratch.
It has the factorization A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per rank-a shear, and the count of recursive calls being the edge-rank sum s.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k ≤ (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} derived from η>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, giving F_k=O(e^τ).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole chain behind the central saving, giving the defining quantity at each link: the fixed bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with the single loss class, rank equal to dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H ← H+D, rank-a shears as a recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. The only blemish is a garbled statement of the deficit's form in a motivation line; the sub-steps state it correctly.
